propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; it must become config-driven via per-project overlay (builtin ← default ← projects.<KEY>) resolved at outbound time.
Unmapped statuses should drift (Jira unchanged, status field omitted, non-fatal deduped warning) rather than coerce or fail.

Config-remapped or collapsed statuses must round-trip losslessly via generalized rebar-status:<local> labels (stamped when Jira target differs from built-in canonical, recovered inbound without reverse map).
The outbound mapper seam must resolve per-project map from repo_root (not CWD) and thread status_map through all CREATE/UPDATE paths and label diffs.
Fetcher and preflight validation must tolerate config-declared status names (derived from mapping_config) beyond the built-in set.
Duplicated rebar-status label parsing logic must be unified into a single derived-vocabulary helper, re-exported in applier.__all__.
